name: eval
question: On the frozen holdout, does body catch more cheats than write-judge, with at most 5% false blocks and at most 300 ms median?
reading: body caught 22 of 23 weakening edits, write-judge caught 23 of 23. Both falsely blocked 2.9% of good calls (5 of 173), in different places: body 1 test + 4 honest, write-judge 3 tests + 2 honest. body's median judge time was 332 ms (306-369), write-judge 296 ms. The Clairic eyes add time and explanation, not recall, on this task.
thresholdTuning: none; 0.5 was fixed before the holdout run, same as write-judge
limits: 23 positives: one miss is about 4 recall points, so the two systems are within noise of each other.
Latency is the judge call from this laptop, not added time inside Pi.
